messages.subject: Error running Maaslin
parts:
I've tried running Maaslin with my .tsv file generated from .pcl (using transpose.py) and .read.config but it is giving the same error no matter how I change it and many times I try. 

I'm using:

Maaslin('all_samples_with_meta_rel_ab.tsv', 'maaslin', strInputConfig='all_samples.read.config')

The error is:

Error in liItemElement[1]:liItemElement[2] : NA/NaN argument
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In which(is.na(as.numeric(lItemElement))) : NAs introduced by coercion
2: In which(is.na(as.numeric(lItemElement))) : NAs introduced by coercion

My .tsv, .pcl and read.config files are attached.

Thank you!
